    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">当 AIR 只支持 Mac，我开始重新思考操作系统这件事</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<section id="nice" data-tool="mdnice编辑器" data-website="https://www.mdnice.com" style="margin: 0; padding: 0 10px; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; font-family: PingFangSC-regular, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); line-height: 1.5em; word-spacing: 0; letter-spacing: 0; overflow-wrap: break-word; text-align: left"><p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">前阵子，我写了一篇关于 JetBrains 新产品 AIR (JetBrains AI IDE) 的文章。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">写那篇文章的初衷，其实很简单——想搞清楚一件事：
当“AI 辅助编程”变成“AI 主导开发”，我们这一代程序员到底要怎么适应。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">但写完之后，评论区和私信里出现了一个更现实的问题：</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0">“Windows 用不了 AIR，那我们怎么办？”</strong></p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">这个问题，比工具本身更值得聊。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">它把一个被很多人忽略的问题重新摆在台面上——
<strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0">操作系统，正在重新分层。</strong></p>
<hr data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); border-bottom: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-left: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-right: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: 1px">
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 30px 0 15px; padding: 0; display: block"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 22px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: bold; display: block">一、一个很真实的瞬间</span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">如果你是 Windows 用户，这一波 AIR 基本是“看得到，用不到”。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">官方目前只支持 macOS，Windows 和 Linux 还在路上。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">这件事让我突然意识到：</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">过去我们选操作系统，更多是习惯问题、性能问题、甚至是价格问题。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">但现在，开始变成：</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0">你能不能用上下一代开发工具。</strong></p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">这就不只是“顺不顺手”了，而是：</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0">你处在技术生态的哪个位置。</strong></p>
<hr data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); border-bottom: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-left: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-right: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: 1px">
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 30px 0 15px; padding: 0; display: block"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 22px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: bold; display: block">二、三个系统，其实代表三种路线</span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">如果把现在主流的三个系统放在一起看，其实差别已经很清晰了：</p>
<ul data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="list-style-type: disc; margin: 8px 0; padding: 0 0 0 25px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
<li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">Windows：大众生态 + 商业软件中心</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">macOS：开发者 + 创意工具的主场</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">Linux：底层能力 + 服务器世界</section></li></ul>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">它们不只是系统，更像三种不同的“技术路径”。</p>
<hr data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); border-bottom: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-left: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-right: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: 1px">
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 30px 0 15px; padding: 0; display: block"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 22px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: bold; display: block">三、Windows：最广，但不再最前沿</span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">Microsoft Windows 几乎是每个计算机学生的起点。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">从装系统、写代码，到打游戏、做项目，大多数人都是在 Windows 上完成的。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">它最大的优势很明显：</p>
<ul data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="list-style-type: disc; margin: 8px 0; padding: 0 0 0 25px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
<li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">软件生态最全</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">学习成本最低</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">兼容性极强</section></li></ul>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">但问题也逐渐显现：</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0">它越来越像“通用平台”，而不是“开发前沿”。</strong></p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">很多新工具，尤其是 AI 相关的开发工具：</p>
<ul data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="list-style-type: disc; margin: 8px 0; padding: 0 0 0 25px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
<li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">优先支持 macOS</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">或者直接面向 Linux</section></li></ul>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">Windows 往往是“后续适配”。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">这并不是 Windows 不强，而是它的定位决定了：</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0">它必须兼容一切，所以很难激进。</strong></p>
<hr data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); border-bottom: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-left: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-right: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: 1px">
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 30px 0 15px; padding: 0; display: block"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 22px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: bold; display: block">四、macOS：为什么越来越多开发者选择它</span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">macOS 这些年的变化，其实挺明显的。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">越来越多开发者，从 Windows 转向 Mac。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">原因不是“更好看”，而是：</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0">它站在一个很微妙的位置——</strong></p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">既有 Unix 的底层能力，又有成熟的桌面生态。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">这带来几个非常关键的优势：</p>
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 30px 0 15px; padding: 0; display: block"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 20px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: bold; display: block">1. 天然接近服务器环境</span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h3>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">macOS 本质上是类 Unix 系统，这一点和 Linux 非常接近。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">你在本地写的很多东西：</p>
<ul data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="list-style-type: disc; margin: 8px 0; padding: 0 0 0 25px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
<li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">Shell 脚本</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">后端服务</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">容器环境</section></li></ul>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">可以更自然地迁移到服务器。</p>
<hr data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); border-bottom: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-left: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-right: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: 1px">
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 30px 0 15px; padding: 0; display: block"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 20px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: bold; display: block">2. 新工具的首发阵地</span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h3>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">这次的 AIR 就是典型例子。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">很多 AI 原生工具，会优先支持 macOS：</p>
<ul data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="list-style-type: disc; margin: 8px 0; padding: 0 0 0 25px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
<li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">系统统一（硬件 + 软件）</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">开发环境稳定</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">用户群体集中</section></li></ul>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">这让它成为：</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0">新一代开发工具的“试验场”。</strong></p>
<hr data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); border-bottom: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-left: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-right: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: 1px">
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 30px 0 15px; padding: 0; display: block"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 20px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: bold; display: block">3. 工具链体验完整</span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h3>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">从：</p>
<ul data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="list-style-type: disc; margin: 8px 0; padding: 0 0 0 25px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">整体体验是“顺”的。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">这种“顺”，其实很难量化，但长期使用的人都会感受到。</p>

<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">Linux 很多人学生时代会“浅尝辄止”，但真正进入行业后会发现：</p>

<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">为什么？</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">因为它在另一个层面几乎是统治级的存在：</p>

<hr data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); border-bottom: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-left: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-right: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: 1px">
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 30px 0 15px; padding: 0; display: block"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 22px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: bold; display: block">九、最后</span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">AIR 现在还不成熟，Windows 也迟早会支持。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">但趋势已经很清楚了：</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">开发这件事，正在从“写代码”，变成：</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0">定义问题 + 驱动 AI + 审查结果</strong></p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">而在这个过程中：</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0">你所处的操作系统生态，会直接影响你的效率和视野。</strong></p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">这才是这件事真正值得思考的地方。</p>
<hr data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); border-bottom: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-left: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-right: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: 1px">
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">如果你现在用的是 Windows：</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">你会因为 AIR 这种工具，考虑换 Mac 吗？</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">还是继续观望？</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">这个选择，没有标准答案，但很可能会影响你接下来几年的开发体验。</p>
</section>
